title: The Judgment on the Valley of Vision
description: Isaiah proclaims a message about the Valley of Vision: A day of confusion and trampling from the Lord strikes Jerusalem. The leaders flee and are captured without a fight, while Elam and Kir advance with chariots and shields. The people strengthen the walls and gather water, but do not look to the One who planned it. When the Lord calls for weeping and mourning, they respond with a feast: "Let us eat and drink, for tomorrow we die!" Therefore the Lord declares that this wickedness will not be forgiven until they die. [ref:Jes 22:1-14|Isaiah 22:1-14]
